Here's a clear rundown of Cartwheel's returns and refund policies:

### Return Window (**cw-returns**)
- The platform default is **30 days from the delivery date** (not the purchase date).
- Items must be returned **in the condition described in the store's listing**.

### Store Overrides (**cw-store-overrides**)
- As a merchant, you can set your **own return window and fees** on your store's policy page — it can be shorter or longer than the 30-day default.
- If your store policy differs from the platform default, **your store policy wins**.

- Approved refunds go back to the **original payment method** and arrive in **5–10 business days**.
- Refunds of **$100 or less** are processed automatically once the order passes the eligibility check.
- Refunds **above $100** are queued for review by a human support agent before any money moves.

### Disputes (**cw-disputes**)
- Buyers can dispute a charge for up to **60 days after delivery**.
- Disputes are always handled by a human agent and will pause any pending refund on the same order.

---

Here's a clear rundown of Cartwheel's returns and refund policies:

### Return Window (**cw-returns**)
- The platform default is **30 days from the delivery date** (not the purchase date).
- Items must be returned **in the condition described in the store's listing**.

### Store Overrides (**cw-store-overrides**)
- As a merchant, you can set your **own return window and fees** on your store's policy page — it can be shorter or longer than the 30-day default.
- If your store policy differs from the platform default, **your store policy wins**.

### Refunds (**cw-refunds**)
- Approved refunds go back to the **original payment method** and arrive in **5–10 business days**.
- Refunds of **$100 or less** are processed automatically once the order passes the eligibility check.
- Refunds **above $100** are queued for review by a human support agent before any money moves.

### Disputes (**cw-disputes**)
- Buyers can dispute a charge for up to **60 days after delivery**.
- Disputes are always handled by a human agent and will pause any pending refund on the same order.

- **Platform default:** You have **30 days from delivery** to return an item. *(cw-store-overrides)*
- **Store overrides:** Individual stores can set their own return windows (shorter or longer). If a store has its own policy, that one wins. *(cw-store-overrides)*

### Refunds
- Approved refunds go back to your **original payment method** and typically arrive in **5–10 business days**. *(cw-refunds)*
- Refunds of **$100 or less** are processed automatically once the order passes the eligibility check. *(cw-refunds)*
- Refunds **over $100** are queued for a human agent to review before the money moves. *(cw-refunds)*

### Disputes
- If needed, you can dispute a charge for up to **60 days after delivery**, though disputes are always handled by a human agent. *(cw-disputes)*
